finalGroupBindings.primaryGround:
Reference lists/bibliographies carry publication details for works cited; they do not define specialist words. Note identifies bibliography’s cited-publication role and matches the source. A list of cited publications does not explain meanings of terms.
An index alphabetizes subjects, people and other important items and points to pages; the manual says not to confuse it with a glossary, which explains words but lacks page references. Note is source-backed and cleanly contrasts index page-location with glossary definition. Index routes readers to pages for subjects; it does not state what specialist terms mean.
Footnotes are notes at the bottom of a page and may contain full publication details; they are notes/citations, not a section defining terms. Note adds supported placement and citation function beyond the label. A page-bottom note is not a book section that collects and explains specialist vocabulary.
The manual says a glossary/key-words section lists difficult or foreign words and explains their meaning; CIEP gloss is a definition of a word/term, hence glossary. Note adds that glossary entries do not give page references, a useful sourced contrast with the index. Only glossary is defined by explaining words/terms; the manual explicitly separates this function from index page references.

authorAssessment.answerTruthAndPlausibility: An index alphabetizes subjects, people and other important items and points to pages; the manual says not to confuse it with a glossary, which explains words but lacks page references.
authorAssessment.noteTruthAndUsefulness: Note is source-backed and cleanly contrasts index page-location with glossary definition.
authorAssessment.uniqueKeyAssessment: Index routes readers to pages for subjects; it does not state what specialist terms mean.

Note is source-backed and cleanly contrasts index page-location with glossary definition.

authorAssessment.answerTruthAndPlausibility: Footnotes are notes at the bottom of a page and may contain full publication details; they are notes/citations, not a section defining terms.
authorAssessment.noteTruthAndUsefulness: Note adds supported placement and citation function beyond the label.
authorAssessment.uniqueKeyAssessment: A page-bottom note is not a book section that collects and explains specialist vocabulary.
